title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. translated_title: 时序权重手术：利用LLM编辑器修复视频定位
translated_abstract: 外科医生先找到问题所在，然后只修复那个部位。我们将这一思想应用于视频定位任务——在该任务中，视频-语言模型常常能在长视频中找到正确的时刻，却把时间写错。在时序权重手术中，一个通用LLM读取模型的权重和激活值，找出错误产生的位置并在那里进行修复，全程无需梯度。多个独立会话找到了相同的错误根源，这种对模型在何处以及为何失败的诊断是我们的主要贡献。三个GPT-6 Astra会话将TimeLens-8B中丢失数字的问题追溯到某一个MLP层，其中最大的一次编辑在1,215个未见问题上带来7.9的mIoU提升，在30分钟及以上的长视频上带来18.3的提升。两个Claude Opus 5.5会话将Qwen3-VL-8B中“分钟被写成秒”的问题追溯到分隔符，分别获得2.9和1.3的提升。在进行任何编辑之前，其答案往往分钟正确而分隔符错误，仅修复分隔符就将其mIoU从13.1提升到19.2。每一项改进……
tldr: 该论文提出时序权重手术（TWS），让通用LLM读取模型的权重与激活值，无需梯度即可定位并修复视频定位任务中时间预测错误的根源，显著提升模型在长视频上的定位精度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), where a general-purpose LLM reads a model's weights and activations to diagnose and repair the root cause of temporal errors in video grounding without gradients, yielding substantial mIoU gains on long videos.
